args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@Gideon Sato, here is the draft for Mateo's procurement team. It uses only the times in #inc-vtg-hartford (all Aug 3, 2026, Central time):

DRAFT: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident summary

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, so the gate recorded trailer numbers by hand. Ticket INC-4821.
- Kiosk 1 restored: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM, per the incident room. The team is watching one more arrival cycle.
- Still open: the status-page access issue on Mateo's login. It is tracked separately from the gate outage. Scheduling from the dispatch office kept working throughout.

I have not sent this anywhere. Any mail to Mateo would need your go-ahead, and anything going outside pemberline.com would need Ruth Calloway's approval.

@Gideon Sato, correction to my draft: the incident room only says at 10:47 that scheduling still worked from the dispatch office. It does not say it worked throughout, so please drop "kept working throughout" before this goes to Mateo's team.

FINAL: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (all times Aug 3, 2026, Central)

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, so the gate recorded trailer numbers by hand.

- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. The team is watching one more arrival cycle.
- Still open: the status-page access issue on Mateo's login is tracked in INC-4821, with the screenshot attached to the ticket. It is separate from the gate outage. Scheduling from the dispatch office was still working at 10:47 AM.
